body.p: Sands & McDougall's Melbourne and Suburban Directory for 1874.
A copy of the full directory is held by Melbourne History Resources, and you can read it online.

The 1874 directory has its own Carlton section (pp. 85–111), covering the area east of the Elizabeth-street extension between Victoria-street east and Park-street, as far east as Nicholson-street and west to Flemington, North Carlton included. Unlike earlier years it lists the streets alphabetically, each street house by house and side by side, with the cross streets in order. All of the section is included here except the short Parkville list under Sydney-road (p. 110). Rathdowne and Berkeley streets are stored as Rathdown and Berkley streets to match the later years, and the "N. Carlton" after some street names is left out of the street name.
The project covers the area south of Grattan Street, west of Swanston Street, east of Elizabeth Street and north of Victoria Street.
